needs.text: Whether Canara Bank sub-let, assigned, or otherwise parted with possession of all or any part of the suit property to Respondents 2-6.
When any relevant subletting or parting with possession was created, including whether it preceded or followed 9 June 1952 and commencement of the Delhi Rent Control Act.
Whether the landlord gave the legally relevant written consent, including the effect of the 1944 lease terms, the 1977 voucher/rent conduct, and the parties' conflicting consent assertions.

What effect, if any, the reported Pratap Bank-to-Lakshmi Commercial Bank and Lakshmi Commercial Bank-to-Canara Bank amalgamations have on tenancy transfer, assignment, possession, or consent under the supplied law.

What role the supplied sections 16-18 notice and sub-tenant-protection provisions can play at this appeal stage, given the parties' procedural dispute and the absence of a prior eviction order in the allowed record.

The fixed graph contains competing characterizations of the 27 March 1944 lease and the 1 March 1977 voucher/rent conduct, but not the full primary text of those instruments; their legal effect cannot be silently reconstructed.

No prescribed section 17 notice document, service date, or respondent-specific notice history is included in the fixed graph; only opposing appellate submissions about notice and procedural scope are supplied.

The record reports Pratap Bank-to-Lakshmi Commercial Bank amalgamation effective 10 December 1961 and Lakshmi Commercial Bank-to-Canara Bank amalgamation effective 23 August 1985, but supplies neither amalgamation scheme, sanction/vesting instrument, enabling statute, nor tenancy-specific term. Applicability of Banking Regulation Act sections 44A/45, the 1980 Acquisition Act section 9, company-law amalgamation rules, or another route therefore remains unresolved.

The fixed facts report that the trial section 14(1)(b) petition was dismissed, but do not separately encode the Respondents 2-4 submission at IK-58386394:L187 that no eviction order had been passed at any stage; that submission is not converted into a new fact.
